messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is built. Open the standalone [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) directly to play offline.

The game includes board codes, snapshot export and import, saved best scores, keyboard controls, and the replay CLI. The source follows the specified separation between the game core, browser session, board, and controls.

Validation passed: locked install, typecheck, unit tests, browser tests, and build. The browser tests cover an offline keyboard game, snapshots, storage, reset timing, and large-board layouts. No screen reader was used; spoken output and real-device long press remain for user acceptance.
